page.title: Work economy settings
page.notice: These settings belong to Work memberships only. They do not control Main packages or Plan pages. Fake/training orders are excluded — economy policy applies to real customer-funded orders only. Changing values here does not grant, deduct, or refund Bids and does not run commission or Elite engines.
page.enginesOff: All economy execution engines are OFF (safe defaults).
page.saveFailed: Save failed. Values were not changed.

priorityBoost.title: 1. Priority Application Boost (active product — dormant)
priorityBoost.lede: Binary boost: 1 Bid + 1 Priority Use. No extra Bids and no automatic assignment. Keep OFF until migration review and cutover are approved.
priorityBoost.help: Uses Membership Priority Uses with the normal Bid cost. Default OFF / DORMANT.

bidPurchases.title: 2. Bids + package purchases (dormant)
bidPurchases.lede: Commercial package Checkout requires BOTH Bid Credits and Bid purchases engines. Keep OFF until Migration 151 is reviewed and cutover is approved. Refund/chargeback Bid reversal is not implemented.

articleMinBids.title: 2a. Mini Bid Article — minimum required applicants
articleMinBids.lede: Creators cannot set a required applicant count below this minimum. Auto-assign stays off.
articleMinBids.autoClose: Auto-close applications when threshold is reached

pantryMinBids.title: 2c. Bayt Al-Mooneh min required bids
pantryMinBids.lede: Minimum applicants for Bayt Al-Mooneh bids. Auto-assign stays off. Legacy requests with no required count keep the current manual accept flow.

normalOrders.title: 2b. Normal Order Admin rules (E3)
normalOrders.lede: Global limits snapshotted onto new bidding Orders. Changing these does not rewrite published Orders. Bid Credits engine stays independent.

fair.title: 3. Fair Work Distribution (internal)
fair.lede: INTERNAL ranking factor among already-eligible freelancers. Never exposed on Freelancer APIs. Eligibility always comes first.
fair.lookbackHelp: Lexicographic queue lookback. Approved default: 30. Source of truth for Phase 7 metrics.
fair.awardResetHelp: APPLIED_AND_LOST increases fairness; decline / freelancer-cancel after award do not get the same boost.

commission.title: 4. Commission
commission.lede: Platform share of completed real work value — configuration only.
commission.pctHelp: Percent the platform earns from completed real work value.

cash.title: 5. Cash membership payments
cash.lede: Admin fee per cash TRANSACTION — not per month, not activation fee, not membership price.
cash.feeHelp: Fixed admin fee per cash membership transaction (not per month).

elite.title: 6. Elite Direct Orders
elite.lede: Global Elite engine policy. Tier eligibility remains on each marketplace plan.
elite.carryForwardHelp: Carry one entitlement when no suitable real matching demand exists (future rules).
elite.declinesHelp: Extensibility flag only. Fake/training demand never counts toward matching.
elite.toggleHelp: Operational switch for the Elite system — distinct from plan-tier Elite capability.

bidCreditsAdmin.title: Bid Credits administration
bidCreditsAdmin.intro: Price Bid packages (quantity, JOD price, validity) and manual grants. Commercial purchase stays dormant until engines are enabled.
bidCreditsAdmin.purchasesNote: No in-app Stripe refund button. Partial refunds require keeping/releasing/revoking remaining Bids manually only.

bidCreditsCard.title: Available Bids
bidCreditsCard.oneBidHint: One Bid = one standard application. Editing a Bid does not consume an extra Bid.
bidCreditsCard.frozenNote: — remaining Bids from this purchase are temporarily unavailable
bidCreditsCard.engineOff: Coming soon — Bid Credits engine is not enabled yet.

validation.hybridUnavailable: {{label}}: HYBRID unavailable until weight policy is defined (FAIR_DISTRIBUTION_HYBRID_WEIGHT_POLICY_REQUIRED).
